2608.26008.title: A Self-Evolving Multi-Agent Framework Defense against LLM Jailbreak Attacks
2608.26008.paper_summary: Large language models (LLMs) remain vulnerable to jailbreak attacks that exploit techniques such as role-playing, obfuscation, code transformation, and multi-step indirection to elicit harmful outputs. As jailbreak strategies keep emerging, defenses have proliferated in an ongoing cat-and-mouse game, yet most remain static: their safety behavior is fixed at deployment, so they cannot accumulate defensive experience or adapt to unseen strategies. We propose a self-evolving test-time defense built around a persistent, cross-interaction rule memory: when an attack succeeds, the framework abstracts that failure into a method-level rule capturing the structural attack wrapper rather than the harmful topic, and reuses it against future inputs. Because rules are method-level, one induced rule generalizes across an entire attack family, and the label space expands as novel wrappers appear. The mechanism operates entirely through external memory and prompting, with no parameter updates, and applies to both open-weight and black-box API models. We realize it as four cooperating modules, but the contribution is the memory-based adaptation mechanism, not the module decomposition. Across four black-box jailbreak families and multiple models, our method substantially reduces attack success rates while preserving benign utility, remains robust under an adaptive composite-wrapper attack, and does not increase over-refusal as the memory grows.
2608.26008.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）仍然容易受到利用角色扮演、模糊化、代碼轉換和多步間接等技術的越獄攻擊，這些攻擊會引發有害的輸出。隨著越獄策略不斷出現，防禦措施在持續的貓捉老鼠遊戲中不斷增長，但大多數仍然是靜態的：它們的安全行為在部署時固定，因此無法累積防禦經驗或適應未見的策略。我們提出了一種自我演變的測試時防禦，建立在持久的跨互動規則記憶之上：當攻擊成功時，該框架將失敗抽象為一個方法級別的規則，捕捉結構性攻擊包裝，而不是有害主題，並在未來的輸入中重用它。由於規則是方法級別的，一個誘導的規則可以跨整個攻擊家族進行概括，並且隨著新包裝的出現，標籤空間擴展。該機制完全通過外部記憶和提示運作，沒有參數更新，並適用於開放權重和黑盒API模型。我們將其實現為四個協作模塊，但貢獻在於基於記憶的適應機制，而不是模塊分解。在四個黑盒越獄家族和多個模型中，我們的方法顯著降低了攻擊成功率，同時保持良性效用，在適應性復合包裝攻擊下保持穩健，並且隨著記憶增長不會增加過度拒絕。
2608.26008.author: Tongyan Hu et.al.
